informal_statement: The extended Euclidean distance between segment endpoints is its length.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:923-936, the source contract is `lemma segmentEndpoint_edist (seg : HorizontalSegment) : edist (planeEuclideanHomeomorph seg.leftEndpoint) (planeEuclideanHomeomorph seg.rightEndpoint) = ENNReal.ofReal seg.euclideanLength`. The length measure is Euclidean one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete frontier. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
